select detail.*, item.item_name as item_name, item.equipment_name as equipment_name, item.unit as unit from wms_inventory_detail detail inner join wms_item_sku sku on detail.sku_id=sku.id inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id
and detail.batch_no like concat('%', #{bo.batchNo}, '%')
and item.item_name like concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
and item.item_code like concat('%', #{bo.itemCode}, '%')
and coalesce(detail.equipment_code, item.item_code) like concat('%', #{bo.equipmentCode}, '%')
and item.equipment_name like concat('%', #{bo.equipmentName}, '%')
and sku.sku_name like concat('%', #{bo.skuName}, '%')
and sku.sku_code like concat('%', #{bo.skuCode}, '%')
and coalesce(detail.spec_model, sku.spec_model, item.model_text) like concat('%', #{bo.specModel}, '%')
and detail.product_mark like concat('%', #{bo.productMark}, '%')
and detail.quality_grade = #{bo.qualityGrade}
and detail.belong_unit like concat('%', #{bo.belongUnit}, '%')
and item.id=#{bo.itemId}
and detail.warehouse_id=#{bo.warehouseId}
and detail.area_id=#{bo.areaId}
and detail.batch_no=#{bo.batchNo}
and (detail.create_time between #{bo.createStartTime} and #{bo.createEndTime})
and (detail.expiration_date between #{bo.expirationStartTime} and #{bo.expirationEndTime})
order by detail.warehouse_id,detail.area_id,sku.item_id,sku.id,detail.create_time
